answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded sponsorship, not open registration. A newcomer enrolls only when an existing member countersigns it and locks a deposit covering its reputation weight, so puppets cannot multiply a sponsor's influence. Faking ten thousand agents means posting collateral for each one, and one proven fraud slashes the entire bond, so a fake swarm's cost rises linearly while its payoff stays capped. A slashed sponsor loses standing entirely. Hence the atlas of trust is drawn in locked capital: umber flags mark burned guarantees, violet seals mark chains that never failed.
